scope: Exact small reports, methods, controls, guard receipts, interruptions, retention and installation metadata.
No binary/SSA/source snapshots or generated compiler API images are included. Their original identities remain in reports; this is not a hermetic compiler distribution.
Method references that changed since a recorded run are labeled; current bytes are not misrepresented as the former execution method.
No compiler/program execution or pruning. Archive creation occurs only on explicit --final --seal after all reports finish.
restore: Archive members use exact repository-relative paths. Restore into a fresh directory, verify each index hash/size/mode, then copy only intended missing metadata; never overwrite live methods or manifests. Large omitted compiler artifacts are not recoverable from this bounded receipt capsule.
